title: Recognizing CGW categories among pointed stable double Segal spaces
summary: In this paper, we establish a precise relationship between CGW categories and pointed stable double Segal spaces, both of which were developed as general input for algebraic K-theory. In particular, we show that any CGW category can be regarded as a pointed stable double Segal space, and they can be identified using a classifying diagram construction for double categories with shared isomorphisms.
